coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .gitignore due to an API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic for transient API errors to prevent a single file failure from making the entire package audit inconclusive.
Consider filtering out or fast-tracking trivial files like .gitignore to save tokens and reduce the chance of API errors on non-executable files.
